pages.title: The Harbinger
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Ancient Factory: the Harbinger's witherite, the wither and void cannons, the laser gatling, the meat shredder, the EMP and the mechanical fusion anvil. Needs Ignis as well.$(br2)$(thing)Relics$(n), ring 10.$(br)$(thing)70 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After The Netherite Monstrosity and Ignis.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Harbinger$(n)$(br2)Pays 12 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
